name: About Modal UI
description: Version and credits dialog. Shows Cockpit IDE branding, app/Electron/Node version keys, and a clickable UseDesign.md link. Closes via button, overlay click, or Escape.

dom.root: .modal-overlay (position: fixed, display: flex/none, inset: 0, background: var(--scrim), align-items: center, justify-content: center, z-index: 10000)

elements.about-modal: .about-modal (role=dialog, aria-modal=true, background: var(--surface), border: 1px dashed var(--border), border-radius: 8px, padding: 40px 48px, min-width: 360px, text-align: center)
elements.about-name: .about-name (font: 28px 'Space Mono', 'Courier New', monospace, font-weight: 700, color: var(--primary), letter-spacing: 6px, id=about-title, aria-labelledby target, text: 'COCKPIT IDE')
elements.about-tagline: .about-tagline (font-size: 12px, color: var(--tertiary), margin-top: 8px, text: 'The IDE for developers who think spatially')
elements.about-link: .about-link (color: var(--accent), text-decoration: underline, cursor: pointer, id=about-design-link, text: 'UseDesign.md')

interactions.name: open_design_link
interactions.action: IPC shell:openExternal with UseDesign.md mashup URL (noir palette, Art Nouveau style, floating design system parameters)
interactions.result: OS browser opens design system viewer

interactions.name: close
interactions.trigger: click on #about-close OR click on .modal-overlay (target === overlay) OR Escape key
interactions.action: Set overlay display:none → Remove Escape keydown listener → Fire onCloseCb callback → Clear onCloseCb

states.open: Overlay display:flex, version specs rendered from electronAPI.versions (VERSION, ELECTRON, NODE, STYLE keys), Escape handler active
states.closed: Overlay display:none, onClose callback fired and cleared

dynamic_content.specs: Version keys built from electronAPI.versions: VERSION (app version or 'dev'), ELECTRON (major version), NODE (major version), STYLE (clickable UseDesign.md link). Array filtered — Electron and Node only shown if available.
